decisions.quote: The current replication and extension evaluated the effects of IF procedures during unmastered primary target trials on the emergence of novel verbal responses. All learners acquired primary, secondary, and related, but unpresented, verbal responses, and maintained responding for 2 months.
decisions.reason: The supplied primary source text (e872e4594c2b69bf.txt, lines 1-4) contains only the title, author list, DOI (10.1002/bin.1836), and abstract. While the title and abstract explicitly state that the study is a replication and extension evaluating instructive feedback (IF) procedures during unmastered primary target trials on the emergence of novel verbal responses, the abstract neither names nor cites the specific original work being replicated. Consequently, primary-source evidence cannot settle the identity of the original target in target_index 0 or determine whether it is already represented by shipped row 455 (Frampton & Shillingsburg, 2019, 10.1002/jaba.659) or is a genuinely omitted target. Prior adjudication and state files were checked and are absent.
